blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–South Korea gatecrashed Japan’s party to win the women’s basketball gold at the Asian Games 2026 on Saturday, surviving a huge late scare to beat the hosts 75-70 in the final. Japan was looking to win the title for the first time since 1998 and it was backed by a noisy crowd at the 17,000-capacity Aichi International Arena in Nagoya. But the Koreans took control of the game early and then held on in the fourth quarter as Japan launched a frantic fightback that fell just short. It was […]...
